related.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
related.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

related.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
related.summary: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.

related.title: Kushner: Trump open to NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine
related.summary: US President Donald Trump is open to offering NATO-like security guarantees to Ukraine, envoy Jared Kushner has said.

main.title: Poland says Russian missile hit its territory during attack on Ukraine
main.summary: Poland on Friday said that no one was hurt after a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine. Polish authorities earlier said they were investigating reports that at ​least two unknown objects had fallen near the border with Ukraine.

related.title: Ministro polacco: "Due missili e un drone russo caduti sul nostro territorio"

related.title: Two missiles crash in Poland amid major Russian attack on Ukraine
related.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russian forces had fired more than 400 attack drones and over 110 missiles at Ukraine overnight.

related.title: Russia hits 3 Kyiv bridges in major attack, while Poland reports airspace violation
related.summary: The overnight strikes, which killed at least five people across Ukraine, came hours after Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response to Ukraine’s attacks on the Crimean bridge.

related.title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
related.summary: Five people were killed in a wave of strikes which follow Ukraine's successful targeting of the Crimean Bridge.

12311185ed.topic: Rappresaglia russa per Kerch: ponti di Kiev colpiti, missili caduti in Polonia
12311185ed.reason: Missili russi caduti sul territorio di un Paese NATO e UE durante il maxi-attacco di rappresaglia su Kiev: è uno sviluppo nuovo e grave, riportato da molte testate, con conseguenze dirette sulla sicurezza europea.
